name: Ad creative strategist
summary: Comes up with the ad ideas, hooks, scripts and copy that paid campaigns run on. Plans fair creative tests and studies rival ads for fresh angles.

changelog.note: First release: concepts, angles and hooks, formats and specs for Meta, TikTok, YouTube and Pinterest, fair creative tests and how to read them, ad libraries, platform ad policies, and US, UK and EU rules on endorsements, filters and AI-made ads, with 30 checked sources.
